programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Herbivores"
programmes.d: Elephants, thrive on vegetation, though they're not averse to confrontation. Rhinos, resilient yet endangered, face threats from predators and humanity. Hippos, formidable and protective, safeguard their young from crocodiles and other predators.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Natural Warriors"
programmes.d: Males and females of most species will fight viciously in self-defense.Females, can be even more aggressive than males when defending their young. We'll expore the Race of Life from the point of view of food,territory,social status and mates.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Run Like the Wind"
programmes.d: Speed is primary defense mechanism, evident in antelopes evading cheetahs. Over millennia, this evolutinary arms race has honer both predator and prey skills.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "The Early Bird (Catches the Worm)"
programmes.d: Analyzing bird predator-prey dynamics reveals three common scenarios: clibing flight, horizontal speeding, and evasive diving.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Reptiles"
programmes.d: Turtles,with their protective shells,persist as ancient survivors in diverse habitats.Snakes,from venomous cobras to harmless species, share common traits and sun-dependent lifestyles.Lizards' adaptive skills include tail loss as a defense mechanism.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Defenses"
programmes.d: Defense mechanisms vary widely, from hyena jaws to frog speed and spider silk. Winning life's race requires a strong defense against predators' advances.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Predators"
programmes.d: In the depths of the ocean, predators reign supreme, from sharks to moray eels.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "Underwater Prey's Defenses"
programmes.d: Life in the ocean demands constant adaptation for survival. From camouflage to group safety, animals employ various strategies to evade predators and secure food.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "The Race Underfoot"
programmes.d: Insects thrive in the relentless Race of Life, with diverse shapes and colors aiding their success.

programmes.t: Race of Life S1 - "The After Dark"
programmes.d: Delve into the shadows to uncover the secrets of nocturnal survival.

programmes.t: Saving the Mustang - America's Horse on the Brink
programmes.d: Saving The Mustang explores the state of wild horses today through the efforts of three individuals. All stories interweave a compelling tale of perseverance and determination.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Mega Towing"
programmes.d: Specialized XXL tow units execute high-risk rescue missions, retrieving heavy military vehicles and towing the world's largest aircraft.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Antonov An-225"
programmes.d: Equipped with six engines, the Antonov An-225 transports massive electrical transformers across the high Andes mountains.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Steel Giant"
programmes.d: In open-pit mines, the massive F60 overburden conveyor bridge moves up to 90,000 tons of soil per shift to extract coal.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"
programmes.d: Maxum Crane tackles a tight indoor lift, JP removes a 60-year-old fighter jet, and Brad and Nathan race to install farm machinery before a storm hits.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Son of a Sailor"
programmes.d: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
programmes.d: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
programmes.d: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Sydney Opera House/Handsaws/Microphones/Icebreaker"
programmes.d: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Moonshine/e-bikes/Wetsuits"
programmes.d: How do they brew moonshine in the heart of New York City? How do they make a battery powered bicycle that can do nearly 30mph? How do they grow the rubber for wetsuits in the Arizona desert?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Gemstones/Cowboy Boots/Road Sweepers"
programmes.d: How do they mine one of the rarest gemstones in the world? How do they craft the classic cowboy boot? How do they build a monster road sweeper that can pick up 7 tonnes of trash?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Duvets/Drill Pipes/Rubber Bands"
programmes.d: How do they make the world’s softest duvets? How do they drill for oil thousands of metres below ground? How do they put the stretch in the world’s stretchiest rubber bands?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Aircraft Engines/Fisherman’s Friend/Plastic Bank Notes/Ice Cream"
programmes.d: How do they build a diesel engine that can fly? How do they make the cough sweet that's been keeping throats clear for 150 years? How do they turn clear plastic into unforgeable bank notes? How do they do the world’s favourite ice cream flavours?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Armored Car/Christmas Trees/Cymbals"
programmes.d: How do they turn a family car into a fortress on wheels? How do they grow millions of perfect Christmas Trees? How do they hammer out the world’s best cymbals?

programmes.t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Strike Planes"
programmes.d: Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

programmes.t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Combat Helicopters"
programmes.d: Ultimate Combat Helicopters offers a fascinating perspective on the technology used to create today’s most powerful combat helicopters.

programmes.t: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Thrill Rides"
programmes.d: Explore the ultimate adrenaline rush – the world’s fastest and scariest thrill rides.

programmes.t: Suppressed Science S1 - "The Suppressed Science Of Psychedelics"
programmes.d: Join Athena as she explores the underground world of psychedelic science, and the revolutionary impact it is poised to have on the pharmaceutical industries.

programmes.t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Race: Science, Social Construct, or Both?"
programmes.d: The concept of race was invented during colonial and imperialist eras as a means to reify political power structures.

programmes.t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Weather Control: The Debate Over Geo-Engineering"
programmes.d: In this episode, Athena takes on the controversial topic of Geoengineering, and meets scientists working on an ambitious plan to put a shield around the planet.

programmes.t: Suppressed Science S1 - "Human Enhancement"
programmes.d: From a cutting-edge, science-based gym & spa, to a medical clinic that offers direct ultrasound brain stimulation designed to increase mental performance.

programmes.t: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
programmes.d: The epic story of 70 years of supersonic innovation, from Chuck Yeager's breakthrough to the future of flight.

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "Winter Flying"
programmes.d: Anthony shows us the different methods to keep yourself and your plane warmed up in those cold winter months.

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
programmes.d: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "Guardian Angels"
programmes.d: Experiencing an aviation emergency where the calm voice on the other end of the radio helps get our pilot out of trouble.

programmes.t: The Aviators S3 - "Oxygen Lab"
programmes.d: Kurtis experiences oxygen deprivation in the High Altitude Lab at Embry Riddle University.

programmes.t: Deep Rising
programmes.d: 'Deep Rising' narrated and executive produced by Jason Momoa, takes viewers on journey from the oceans depths to the future of sustainable energy.
